claims.claim: Elon Musk said SpaceX has closed a $40 billion debt financing package to purchase graphics processing units (GPUs) that will power the company’s artificial‑intelligence systems.The proposed financing would use a special purpose vehicle to keep the debt off SpaceX's balance sheet and preserve its investment‑grade credit ratings, according to Bloomberg.
claims.evidence: Elon Musk said SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt financing to purchase graphics processing units, or GPUs, used to power artificial intelligence systems. Elon Musk announced on Sunday that SpaceX had closed $40 billion in debt financing to purchase graphics processing units (GPUs), marking another major investment in artificial intelligence as technology companies race to expand their computing infrastructure. SpaceX has secured $40 billion in debt financing to buy graphics processing units (GPUs), the chips used to run AI systems, Elon Musk said in a post on X on Sunday. SpaceX’s $40 billion debt deal illustrates how the company is expanding beyond launch services into the AI hardware arena.No statement about a broader trend has been made.
